name: goose-builtin-runtime
title: Builtin goose runtime: ACP-based second bundled agent with NAP optimizations
description: Add goose as a second builtin agent runtime alongside pi, speaking ACP. Port NAP's three optimizations: per-session SQLite isolation (GOOSE_PATH_ROOT), session-id bidirectional mapping (codec), and accurate usage via _goose/unstable ext notifications. goose LLM connects direct to OpenAI-compatible provider (not via pi's backend relay). First phase: PATH-detected goose binary; bundling the Rust binary into the daemon distribution is a follow-up packaging task.
creator: 张岩.ean
notes: Audited + fixed (autostart, control capture, per-turn usage); product side wired (backend whitelist + frontend UI); verified end-to-end on an isolated stack incl. activity timeline. Reusable guide: .trellis/spec/guides/add-runtime-workflow.md
